## What the National Ignition Facility’s Fusion Result Shows

An experiment at the National Ignition Facility achieved fusion ignition, generating 3.15 megajoules of fusion energy after delivering 2.05 megajoules to the target. On this target-level measure, the fusion output exceeded the energy delivered to the target.

That comparison marks progress toward inertial fusion energy, but it does not mean practical energy production has been achieved. Substantial scientific and technological development is still required.
